verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֶת־ תִּשְׁמְר֕וּ לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִ֖י בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃ לַחְמִ֜י קָרְבָּנִ֨י לְאִשַּׁ֗י נִֽיחֹחִ֔י רֵ֚יחַ
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- tiš·mə·rū lə·haq·rîḇ lî bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏōw laḥ·mî qā·rə·bā·nî lə·’iš·šay nî·ḥō·ḥî rê·aḥ
verses.literal: Command - the Israelites . . . and say to them - See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food vvv for My food offerings as a pleasing aroma to Me

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם זֶ֚ה הָֽאִשֶּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ לַיהוָ֑ה תָמִֽיד׃ עֹלָ֥ה לַיּ֖וֹם שְׁנַ֥יִם תְמִימִ֛ם בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֧ה כְּבָשִׂ֨ים
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lā·hem zeh hā·’iš·šeh ’ă·šer taq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh ṯā·mîḏ ‘ō·lāh lay·yō·wm šə·na·yim ṯə·mî·mim bə·nê- šā·nāh kə·ḇā·śîm
verses.literal: And tell them [that] this [is] the food offering - you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day two unblemished year-old . . . male lambs

verses.original: אֶת־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶחָ֖ד הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ta·‘ă·śeh ’e·ḥāḏ hak·ke·ḇeś ḇab·bō·qer wə·’êṯ haš·šê·nî ta·‘ă·śeh hak·ke·ḇeś bên hā·‘ar·bā·yim
verses.literal: - Offer one lamb in the morning - and the other . . . - at twilight

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָאֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְמִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃ בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·rîṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh sō·leṯ lə·min·ḥāh bə·lū·lāh rə·ḇî·‘iṯ ha·hîn bə·še·men kā·ṯîṯ
verses.literal: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed [olives]

verses.original: תָּמִ֑יד עֹלַ֖ת הָעֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י נִיחֹ֔חַ לְרֵ֣יחַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tā·mîḏ ‘ō·laṯ hā·‘ă·śu·yāh bə·har sî·nay nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: וְנִסְכּוֹ֙ הָאֶחָ֑ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַהִ֔ין הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַיהוָֽה׃ בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: wə·nis·kōw hā·’e·ḥāḏ lak·ke·ḇeś rə·ḇî·‘iṯ ha·hîn has·sêḵ ne·seḵ šê·ḵār Yah·weh baq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The drink offering accompanying each lamb [shall be] a quarter hin Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִ֔י הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת וּכְנִסְכּוֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה הַבֹּ֤קֶר אִשֵּׁ֛ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵ֥יחַ לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ta·‘ă·śeh haš·šê·nî hak·ke·ḇeś bên hā·‘ar·bā·yim kə·min·ḥaṯ ū·ḵə·nis·kōw ta·‘ă·śeh hab·bō·qer ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering . . . as in the morning It is a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וּבְיוֹם֙ שְׁנֵֽי־ תְּמִימִ֑ם בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֖ה כְבָשִׂ֥ים מִנְחָ֛ה וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šab·bāṯ ū·ḇə·yō·wm šə·nê- tə·mî·mim bə·nê- šā·nāh ḵə·ḇā·śîm min·ḥāh ū·šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men wə·nis·kōw
verses.literal: On the Sabbath day present two unblemished year-old . . . male lambs accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with oil as well as a drink offering

verses.original: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ עַל־ הַתָּמִ֖יד עֹלַ֥ת וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·laṯ šab·baṯ bə·šab·bat·tōw ‘al- hat·tā·mîḏ ‘ō·laṯ wə·nis·kāh
verses.literal: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath . . . in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering

verses.original: וּבְרָאשֵׁי֙ חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ לַיהוָ֑ה עֹלָ֖ה שְׁנַ֙יִם֙ בְּנֵֽי־ בָקָ֤ר פָּרִ֨ים אֶחָ֔ד וְאַ֣יִל שִׁבְעָ֖ה כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·rā·šê ḥā·ḏə·šê·ḵem taq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh ‘ō·lāh šə·na·yim bə·nê- ḇā·qār pā·rîm ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’a·yil šiḇ·‘āh kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh tə·mî·mim
verses.literal: At the beginning of every month you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young . . . bulls one ram and seven male lambs a year old . . . all unblemished

verses.original: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן מִנְחָה֙ הָאֶחָ֑ד לַפָּ֖ר וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן מִנְחָה֙ לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men min·ḥāh hā·’e·ḥāḏ lap·pār ū·šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men min·ḥāh lā·’a·yil hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: along with three-tenths [of an ephah] . . . of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull two-tenths [of an ephah] . . . of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram . . .

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן מִנְחָה֙ הָאֶחָ֑ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ עֹלָה֙ נִיחֹ֔חַ רֵ֣יחַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘iś·śā·rōn ‘iś·śā·rō·wn sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men min·ḥāh hā·’e·ḥāḏ lak·ke·ḇeś ‘ō·lāh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: and a tenth [of an ephah] . . . of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb This is a burnt offering a pleasing aroma a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם יִהְיֶ֨ה חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יָ֑יִן לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ זֹ֣את חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ עֹלַ֥ת בְּחָדְשׁ֔וֹ לְחָדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nis·kê·hem yih·yeh ḥă·ṣî ha·hîn yā·yin lap·pār ū·šə·lî·šiṯ ha·hîn lā·’a·yil ū·rə·ḇî·‘iṯ ha·hîn lak·ke·ḇeś zōṯ ḥō·ḏeš ‘ō·laṯ bə·ḥā·ḏə·šōw lə·ḥā·ḏə·šê haš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull a third of a hin with the ram and a quarter hin with each lamb This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon . . . throughout the year

verses.original: עַל־ הַתָּמִ֛יד עֹלַ֧ת וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃ס אֶחָ֛ד וּשְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לְחַטָּ֖את
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hat·tā·mîḏ ‘ō·laṯ wə·nis·kōw ’e·ḥāḏ ū·śə·‘îr ‘iz·zîm yê·‘ā·śeh Yah·weh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering one male goat . . . is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering

verses.original: בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃ פֶּ֖סַח
verses.transliteration: bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn ū·ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš Yah·weh pe·saḥ
verses.literal: The fourteenth . . . day - of the first month is the LORD’s Passover

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm haz·zeh la·ḥō·ḏeš ḥāḡ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm maṣ·ṣō·wṯ yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of this month there shall be a feast for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten

verses.original: הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בַּיּ֥וֹם קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִקְרָא־ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn bay·yō·wm qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly you must not do any regular work . . .

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם לַֽיהוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ שְׁנַ֖יִם בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר פָּרִ֧ים אֶחָ֑ד וְאַ֣יִל וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃ תְּמִימִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tem Yah·weh ’iš·šeh ‘ō·lāh šə·na·yim bə·nê- ḇā·qār pā·rîm ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’a·yil wə·šiḇ·‘āh ḵə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê šā·nāh yih·yū lā·ḵem tə·mî·mim
verses.literal: Present to the LORD a food offering a burnt offering of two young . . . bulls one ram and seven male lambs a year old . . . all unblemished

verses.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯām sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men ta·‘ă·śū šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm lap·pār ū·šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm lā·’a·yil
verses.literal: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil offer three-tenths [of an ephah] . . . with each bull two-tenths [of an ephah] . . . with the ram

verses.original: תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃ לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śeh ‘iś·śā·rō·wn ‘iś·śā·rō·wn hā·’e·ḥāḏ lə·šiḇ·‘aṯ hak·kə·ḇā·śîm lak·ke·ḇeś
verses.literal: and a tenth [of an ephah] . . . with each of the seven . . . lambs

verses.original: אֶחָ֑ד וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥāḏ ū·śə·‘îr ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you

verses.original: תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ אֵֽלֶּה׃ מִלְּבַד֙ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הַתָּמִ֑יד לְעֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר עֹלַ֣ת
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- ’êl·leh mil·lə·ḇaḏ ’ă·šer hat·tā·mîḏ lə·‘ō·laṯ hab·bō·qer ‘ō·laṯ
verses.literal: You are to present - these in addition to the regular - morning burnt offering

verses.original: תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ כָּאֵ֜לֶּה לֶ֛חֶם לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים אִשֵּׁ֥ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַיהוָ֑ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה עַל־ וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃ הַתָּמִ֛יד עוֹלַ֧ת
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śū kā·’êl·leh le·ḥem lay·yō·wm šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh yê·‘ā·śeh ‘al- wə·nis·kōw hat·tā·mîḏ ‘ō·w·laṯ
verses.literal: Offer the same food each day for seven days as a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבַיּוֹם֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ מִקְרָא־ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ḇay·yō·wm yih·yeh lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly you must not do any regular work . . .

verses.original: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם חֲדָשָׁה֙ מִנְחָ֤ה לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ מִֽקְרָא־ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm hab·bik·kū·rîm bə·haq·rî·ḇə·ḵem ḥă·ḏā·šāh min·ḥāh Yah·weh bə·šā·ḇu·‘ō·ṯê·ḵem yih·yeh lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš miq·rā- lō ṯa·‘ă·śū kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: On the day of firstfruits when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks you are to hold a sacred assembly you must not do any regular work . . .

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה שְׁנַ֖יִם בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר פָּרִ֧ים אֶחָ֑ד אַ֣יִל שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לְרֵ֤יחַ לַֽיהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ‘ō·w·lāh šə·na·yim bə·nê- ḇā·qār pā·rîm ’e·ḥāḏ ’a·yil šiḇ·‘āh ḵə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê šā·nāh nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Present a burnt offering of two young . . . bulls one ram and seven male lambs a year old . . . as a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לַפָּ֣ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯām sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm hā·’e·ḥāḏ lap·pār šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm lā·’a·yil hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil three-tenths [of an ephah] . . . with each bull two-tenths [of an ephah] . . . with the ram . . .

verses.original: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃ לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ
verses.transliteration: ‘iś·śā·rō·wn ‘iś·śā·rō·wn hā·’e·ḥāḏ lə·šiḇ·‘aṯ hak·kə·ḇā·śîm lak·ke·ḇeś
verses.literal: and a tenth [of an ephah] . . . with each of the seven . . . lambs

verses.original: אֶחָ֑ד שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥāḏ śə·‘îr ‘iz·zîm lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Include one male goat . . . to make atonement for you

verses.original: תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ מִלְּבַ֞ד הַתָּמִ֛יד עֹלַ֧ת וּמִנְחָת֖וֹ יִהְיוּ־ לָכֶ֖ם תְּמִימִ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śū wə·nis·kê·hem mil·lə·ḇaḏ hat·tā·mîḏ ‘ō·laṯ ū·min·ḥā·ṯōw yih·yū- lā·ḵem tə·mî·mim
verses.literal: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering The animals must be unblemished
